The operator's site says 'CALL to BOOK NOW' (406) 682-3088; its policy links point to its Campspot booking page. Payment due on arrival; cancellations over 30 days out refunded less $5. One RV and up to two other vehicles per site. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Private resort on MT-287 near the Madison River (~1 mi N of Three Dollar Bridge), Cameron, between Ennis and West Yellowstone; formerly the Howlin Mad Moon Resort. RV sites plus deluxe cabins, a group tent area, horse corrals and a restaurant. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: confirmed electric-only hookups (no water/sewer), showers, store, seasonal. Added laundry and wifi, season closes Dec 1 (opening not stated), Campspot booking. Not confirmed: 50-amp, 24 pull-through sites (derived, left; the operator does not say). No dated rate: the hunting page's undated '$30' RV rate was not recorded. Note trimmed of restated values.
